mentions.name: StockEvents AI
mentions.description: An AI assistant for investment questions that returns up-to-date answers in about 5 seconds, grounded directly in the project's database to reduce hallucinations. Currently still in development.
mentions.problem: Investment AI answers are slow (around 50 seconds) and prone to hallucinations without grounded data.
mentions.source_excerpt: From 50 to 5 seconds. The world's fastest and most up to date investment ai. It's powered directly through our database to ground the information and reduce hallucinations. Still in development though.
